chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, raising it from a man, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

While the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) was in the mosque, he suddenly said: Stand up, O so-and-so! Stand up, O so-and-so! Stand up, O so-and-so! — until he had expelled five persons.
Then he said: Get out from our mosque — do not pray in it while you are not giving zakat.

key_terms.فُلَانُ: So-and-so — used in Arabic to refer to unnamed persons
key_terms.مَسْجِدِنَا: Our mosque — the Prophet's possessive reflects the sanctity of the mosque as a place reserved for those who fulfill their duties
key_terms.يَرْفَعُهُ: Raising it (mursal) — technical hadith term indicating a gap in the chain of transmission
key_terms.يُزَكُّونَ: Give zakat — to pay the obligatory annual alms-tax

ai.seo_question: What happens if someone prays but does not pay zakat according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrates that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) expelled five unnamed individuals from his mosque because they were performing salat while withholding zakat. This narration illustrates the inseparable connection between ritual prayer and the obligation of zakat in Islamic practice — those who refuse to pay zakat are considered unworthy of the sacred space of the mosque. The hadith comes with a weak chain (mursal), as Ibn Muskan transmits it through an unnamed intermediary, but its legal-theological content is significant in discussions of zakat's obligatory status.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, raising it from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘While Rasool-Allahsaww was in the Masjid when hesaww said: ‘Stand, O so and so! Stand O son of so! Stand O so and so!’, until hesaww has thrown out five persons, and hesaww said: ‘Get out from oursaww Masjid! Do not pray Salāt in it and you are not giving Zakāt’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Isma’if ibn Marrar from Yunus from ibn Muskan in a marfu‘ manner from a man who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Once, when, in the Masjid, the Messenger of Allah asked several people to stand up. They numbered five people
and then he asked them, ’Leave our Masjid. Do not perform Salah (prayer) here; you do not pay zakat.’”
